metadata.title: HPECOMCmdlets
metadata.description: The HPE Compute Ops Management PowerShell library offers a comprehensive suite of cmdlets designed to manage and automate your HPE GreenLake environment. By leveraging this library, users can seamlessly interact with HPE GreenLake and Compute Ops Management services directly from the PowerShell command line, enabling efficient integration into existing automation workflows and enhancing operational efficiency.

findings.title: Possible hard-coded credential
findings.description: A credential-like variable appears to be assigned a literal value. Review the source; the matched value is redacted.

findings.title: Plain text is converted to a secure string
findings.description: File 'file-00018.psm1' uses ConvertTo-SecureString with plaintext. This will expose secure information. Encrypted standard strings should be used instead.

findings.title: Plain text password parameter is declared
findings.description: Parameter '$AccountServicePasswordComplexity' should not use String type but either SecureString or PSCredential, otherwise it increases the chance to expose this sensitive information.

findings.title: Separate username and password parameters are declared
findings.description: Function 'New-HPECOMSettingiLOSettings' has both Username and Password parameters. Either set the type of the Password parameter to SecureString or replace the Username and Password parameters with a Credential parameter of type PSCredential. If using a Credential parameter in PowerShell 4.0 or earlier, please define a credential transformation attribute after the PSCredential type attribute.
